source_evidence: Exact player 'enter with light' authorizes entering the existing fissure with illumination, not taking property or entering a new hazardous descent. At D338~06:10 Cirren casts prepared-known Light cantrip on his own shield (2014 bright light20ft/dim additional20ft, 1h until~07:10, nonconcentration, no slot); retains Detect Magic concentration until~06:20. V, Cirren and Fenar enter together; Mara independently stays with the intact coach/four horses nearby on road. Proceed cautiously through the established initial10ft straight fissure and another roughly35ft of rough gently descending natural passage, reaching a small worked chamber about45ft from entrance by~06:13. DM establishes finite initial explored geometry: chamber roughly25ft long by20ft wide, ceiling6–9ft, rough floor, accessible return passage, no forced squeeze/climb/fall, no additional creature observed or encounter triggered. Seven crude bedding places, ordinary water/food remnants, sorted rock piles, three tied ore sacks at wall, and a newly exposed dense dull silver-gray metallic-looking vein in pale stone are directly visible; short chalk Undercommon marks by sorted piles translate literally via Fenar as 'poor stone' and 'silver stone'. Evidence establishes Derro identified and separated material they believed silver-bearing; no assay, exact composition, weight, market value, commercially viable deposit, ownership, wider faction or ultimate motive confirmed. These mundane objects remain where found, no custody transfer. A narrow natural passage opens at chamber's far side and descends out of sight; old rope secured to rock at its lip and repeated scrape/boot marks indicate prior use, no surveyed depth, safe route, further occupants or destination verified. Detect Magic detects no new nonparty magical presence within effective range from explored chamber and accessible passage; Light shield and existing carried magic are expected, no claim about farther or blocked areas. No hidden door/trap conclusively ruled out, no search/assay or hazardous descent undertaken. No dice warranted for visible features or Fenar reading straightforward known language; no new damage, limited resources, supplies, purchases, loot or quest progress beyond discovery. Pause at chamber before V chooses further examination or descent. No connection to V ancestry asserted.
